sentences.text: When an AI agent says it "remembers" you, is that architecture or a marketing word?
sentences.text_raw: When an AI agent says it "remembers" you, is that architecture or a marketing word?

sentences.text: This filing answers with a five-step loop, and step two reads a per-user store of memory objects built from your prior chats.
sentences.text_raw: This filing answers with a five-step loop, and step two reads a per-user store of memory objects built from your prior chats.

sentences.text: That store is drawn as a box of its own.
sentences.text_raw: That store is drawn as a box of its own.

sentences.text: What the datastore holds is not a transcript.
sentences.text_raw: What the datastore holds is not a transcript.

sentences.text: Its unit is the memory object, a container holding one or more memory values: strings, images, or audio.
sentences.text_raw: Its unit is the memory object, a container holding one or more memory values: strings, images, or audio.

sentences.text: Beside each value sits metadata: a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, a summary of the interaction.
sentences.text_raw: Beside each value sits metadata: a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, a summary of the interaction.

sentences.text: Who decides what the agent keeps?
sentences.text_raw: Who decides what the agent keeps?

sentences.text: A model does.
sentences.text_raw: A model does.

sentences.text: In a memory update cycle, cached inputs go to the model, which predicts what to remember, extracts it, and writes it as a memory object.
sentences.text_raw: In a memory update cycle, cached inputs go to the model, which predicts what to remember, extracts it, and writes it as a memory object.

sentences.text: Saying "remember this" is one trigger, and the write can run offline.
sentences.text_raw: Saying "remember this" is one trigger, and the write can run offline.

sentences.text: Recall is not a reread of everything.
sentences.text_raw: Recall is not a reread of everything.

sentences.text: In the recall cycle, the agent scores stored objects against the query, comparing embeddings by a measure like cosine similarity.
sentences.text_raw: In the recall cycle, the agent scores stored objects against the query, comparing embeddings by a measure like cosine similarity.

sentences.text: Only a top subset comes back, ordered by timestamp so the model sees what is recent.
sentences.text_raw: Only a top subset comes back, ordered by timestamp so the model sees what is recent.

sentences.text: Memories can be corrected.
sentences.text_raw: Memories can be corrected.

sentences.text: New input arrives with a timestamp, is matched to a prior memory object, and either replaces it or updates it.
sentences.text_raw: New input arrives with a timestamp, is matched to a prior memory object, and either replaces it or updates it.

sentences.text: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one, so new information refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.
sentences.text_raw: Aligned objects can be consolidated into one, so new information refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.

sentences.text: Forgetting is claimed, not just remembering.
sentences.text_raw: Forgetting is claimed, not just remembering.

sentences.text: "Forget that" deletes the specified information from the datastore.
sentences.text_raw: "Forget that" deletes the specified information from the datastore.

sentences.text: "Forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.
sentences.text_raw: "Forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.

sentences.text: Expired objects are swept in maintenance, and the same chat erases what it built.
sentences.text_raw: Expired objects are swept in maintenance, and the same chat erases what it built.

sentences.text: Before answering, the model can analyze your query against the recalled memory.
sentences.text_raw: Before answering, the model can analyze your query against the recalled memory.

sentences.text: That analysis is not shown on screen.
sentences.text_raw: That analysis is not shown on screen.

sentences.text: The response itself can be an API call that makes a device act, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.
sentences.text_raw: The response itself can be an API call that makes a device act, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.

sentences.text: There are no benchmark numbers here.
sentences.text_raw: There are no benchmark numbers here.

sentences.text: The claimed difference is structural: memory objects made from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.
sentences.text_raw: The claimed difference is structural: memory objects made from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.

sentences.text: That is an architecture you can read, not a slogan.
sentences.text_raw: That is an architecture you can read, not a slogan.

sentences.text: The filing is WO2026-128750A1, with a 2024 priority and a 2026 publication.
sentences.text_raw: The filing is WO2026-128750A1, with a 2024 priority and a 2026 publication.
